extracted.intended_audience: readers and writers of philosophical/Victorian prose; students of literature and those seeking moral/creative guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Producing or interpreting essayistic, philosophical prose in the Carlylean/Victorian tradition — guidance on moral stance, creative practice, and the role of forms/vestures in society. Emphasizes practical exhortations (action, production), symbolic thought, and the relationship of spirit to outward forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize spiritual love over pleasure
rubrics_metrics.description: "Love not Pleasure; love God. This is the EVERLASTING YEA, wherein all contradiction is solved: wherein whoso walks and works, it is well with him."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames a moral criterion: spiritual love (God) rather than pursuit of pleasure is the lasting affirmative that resolves contradiction in life; when one follows this, conduct and well-being follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value the 'Worship of Sorrow' and its enduring altar
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to a "Worship of Sorrow" whose temple, though in ruins and overgrown, still contains an Altar and a sacred Lamp perennially burning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages recognition of sorrow as a legitimate and perennial spiritual locus; even if its outward institutions are ruined, the inner altar persists and merits attention rather than dismissal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek Partial Inspiration rather than quarrelling over Plenary Inspiration
rubrics_metrics.description: "try rather to get a little even Partial Inspiration, each of you for himself. One BIBLE I know, of whose Plenary Inspiration doubt is not so much as possible... thereof all other Bibles are but Leaves"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical admonition for belief and creative/spiritual life: avoid tearing one another over doctrinal 'plenary' claims; aim for attainable, personal inspiration and experiential certainty rather than endless speculative dispute.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convert conviction into conduct — action removes doubt
rubrics_metrics.description: "Conviction, were it never so excellent, is worthless till it convert itself into Conduct... 'Doubt of any sort cannot be removed except by Action.'"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A standard for evaluating inner belief or theoretical insight: its value is measured by whether it leads to concrete action. For writers and thinkers: translate thought into practiced duty; acting clarifies and settles doubts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do the duty nearest to you
rubrics_metrics.description: "Do the Duty which lies nearest thee, which thou knowest to be a Duty! Thy second Duty will already have become clearer."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical rule-of-thumb: when overwhelmed by speculation or uncertainty, take the immediately knowable ethical/creative task and perform it; subsequent obligations will be revealed through that doing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Realize the Ideal in the Actual ('here or nowhere')
rubrics_metrics.description: "When your Ideal World... becomes revealed... that your 'America is here or nowhere'? The Situation that has not its Duty, its Ideal, was never yet occupied by man."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creative/moral criterion: one must seek and enact one's ideal within present circumstances rather than awaiting imagined elsewhere; the material at hand is the raw stuff for forming the ideal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision (Light) is the beginning of Creation
rubrics_metrics.description: "The beginning of Creation is--Light. Till the eye have vision, the whole members are in bonds... Divine moment, when... it is spoken: Let there be Light!"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluative principle for work and thought: insight or clarifying vision is the formative beginning that orders chaos into a coherent structure; seek or wait for such illuminating moments to organize labor or composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce — even the smallest product matters; work with whole might
rubrics_metrics.description: "Produce! Produce! Were it but the pitifullest infinitesimal fraction of a Product, produce it... Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy whole might. Work while it is called To-day; for the Night cometh..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A criterion of creative integrity and urgency: output (however small) and wholehearted engagement are prized. Do not delay or excuse production; sustained, earnest effort is morally and artistically imperative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Pen: writing is a wonder-working tool
rubrics_metrics.description: "Tools? Hast thou not a Brain... and three fingers to hold a Pen withal? Never since Aaron's Rod... was there such a wonder-working Tool: greater than all recorded miracles have been performed by Pens."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions writing as the primary creative instrument: the word endures and effects change in the world. For writers: regard writing as a powerful obligation and tool for making and reshaping thought and society.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small ideas can grow into world-working institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Teufelsdrockh's suggestion that some 'pregnant Device' or idea, like a grain of mustard-seed, may have been the origin of far-reaching institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not dismiss modest or early-stage ideas; encourage and realize them because they may scale into influential institutions or movements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judge the person by spirit and becoming, not by mere enumerated facts
rubrics_metrics.description: "Wilt thou know a Man, above all a Mankind, by stringing together bead-rolls of what thou namest Facts? The Man is the spirit he worked in; not what he did, but what he became."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methodological criterion for biography, criticism, and interpretation: prioritize the inner spirit, effects, and development of a life over a dry catalogue of external facts; facts without interpretive key (hierograms) are of limited value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspect literalness in autobiographical documents — consider mystification
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editor's suspicion that the 'Autobiographical Documents are partly a mystification' and that 'what was but hieroglyphically so' may have been received too literally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critical caution: when dealing with eccentric autobiographical material, consider symbolic or allegorical readings; do not assume transparent factual accuracy when the author characteristically obscures or plays with truth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Church‑Clothes (forms/vestures) embody and sustain religion and society
rubrics_metrics.description: "By Church-Clothes... I mean infinitely more than Cassocks and Surplices... the Forms, the Vestures, under which men have at various periods embodied and represented for themselves the Religious Principle..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sociocultural standard: institutional and symbolic forms are necessary for religion to manifest outwardly and for society to be social rather than merely gregarious; without such vestures the social body risks decay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classify churches by vitality: preaching/prophesying vs. dumb/decrepit
rubrics_metrics.description: Three predicaments: (1) an audibly preaching and prophesying Church (best); (2) a Church that struggles to preach but awaits Pentecost; (3) a Church gone dumb with old age (worst).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluative typology for religious/social institutions: prefer living, prophetic forms; recognize and diagnose institutions that have become mere shells awaiting renewal or dissolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beware hollow forms and sham-priests — forms without spirit are dangerous
rubrics_metrics.description: "many of them have become mere hollow Shapes, or Masks, under which no living Figure or Spirit any longer dwells; but only spiders and unclean beetles... a Sham-priest... the falsest and basest; neither is it doubtful that his Canonicals... will one day be torn from him."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anti-pattern warning: when outward forms persist without inner life, they produce corruption and must be judged and re-textured; in creative or institutional practice guard against performative formality that lacks substance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Silence and secrecy foster the making of great things
rubrics_metrics.description: "The benignant efficacies of Concealment... SILENCE and SECRECY! Altars might still be raised to them... Silence is the element in which great things fashion themselves together; that at length they may emerge, full-formed and majestic, into the daylight of Life..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creative-process criterion: avoid premature publicizing or babbling of projects; allow ideas to be formed in quiet and secrecy so they can emerge maturely into the world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivate Passivity (the Passive half-duty) when curing is impossible
rubrics_metrics.description: "We have here not a Whole Duty of Man, yet a Half Duty, namely the Passive half: could we but do it, as we can demonstrate it!" — practice enduring pain if it cannot be cured; show generosity when another takes more than their share.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Moral criterion: recognize and practice the passive/deliberative side of duty (forgiveness, endurance, relinquishment) as an essential complement to active duties; this is ethically valuable and demonstrable by action.
